segments.text: Her lifeboat is being dragged into the propellers. So she jumps. It is her third ship disaster in five years.
Three? No chance. Let's go look.
{1911|Nineteen eleven}. Violet Jessop is a stewardess on the liner Olympic. It collides with a warship. Torn open, it limps home.
{1912|Nineteen twelve}. She joins the sister ship. Titanic. Iceberg. In the lifeboat, someone thrusts a baby into her arms.
{1916|Nineteen sixteen}. The third sister, Britannic, a hospital ship, hits a mine. This time, she grabs her toothbrush.
But the propellers are still turning, and they pull the lifeboats in. She jumps. Her skull is fractured.
And she lives. Then she goes back to sea, until {1950|nineteen fifty}.
Three sister ships. One stewardess. I was wrong. Case closed.
